title: Hány éves vagy? — Asking and Saying Age

sections.content: Use [number] éves vagyok to state your age, and Hány éves vagy? to ask someone theirs — the question and the answer share the exact same word order, just swap hány for an actual number.
sections.title: Age with éves

sections.content: Word order is number, then éves, then vagyok — literally 'thirty years am,' the reverse of English 'I am thirty.' Talking about someone else drops vagyok/van entirely, the same zero-copula pattern from Unit 1 (Ő Anna, not Ő van Anna): Hány éves? and Harminc éves — nothing to conjugate at all.
